Privacy

Short version: we only store what's needed to send you the weekly email.

What we store when you subscribe

  • Your email address
  • When you signed up
  • A one-way hash of your IP address, kept only to limit spam signups (we never store the IP address itself)
  • If you use "Watch this store": which stores you watch

How we use it

Only to send the ShopBot Index email (about one a week: which stores started or stopped publishing a UCP profile, and what else changed) and, if you watch a store, an email when that store starts or stops publishing a UCP profile. Every alert has a link to stop alerts for that store. We don't sell or share your data, and we don't add you to other lists.

Where it's kept

Subscriber data is stored with Supabase (EU region, Frankfurt), and emails will be sent with Resend. Both act as processors for us.

Unsubscribe and deletion

Every email will have a one-click unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing removes you from the list. To have your data deleted, or for any question, write to hello@shopbotindex.com.

Visit counts

This site uses no cookies and no third-party analytics or tracking. To see which pages people read, each page sends one anonymous count to our own database (Supabase, EU): the page's path, the domain of the website that linked to it, and any utm or ref tags in the link. We store only daily totals of those. We don't store your IP address, any identifier, your browser or device, or anything else about you, so a visit can't be linked to you or to your other visits. If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, nothing is sent.

Spam protection

Our signup forms have a hidden field that people never see or fill in. When it's filled, we drop the signup and add one to a daily count; nothing else about that request is stored.

Affiliate links

Shopify trial links on this site are affiliate links run through Impact; when you click one, Shopify and Impact may set their own cookies to attribute a trial. We may earn a commission if you start a Shopify trial through our links.

Our crawler

ShopBot Index reads a short, fixed list of public files and pages on the stores it tracks (robots.txt, the UCP profile, a few agent-related files, the home page and one product page; full list in the methodology), respects robots.txt, and identifies itself honestly. See the methodology.

Questions about your data: hello@shopbotindex.com.
